label: Puck.js switch (light), command to write acknowledged
measures: Home Assistant command to the device's GATT write acknowledgement, as the integration times it
fast_window_note: Every sample carries idle_for_s, the time between the previous connection closing and this command being issued, and device_idle, whether that exceeds fast_timeout_ms. A first command is only counted when the device had fallen back to the interval under test; a following one only when it had not. The sweep originally stamped that time after the command returned, which charged the command's own duration to it; the field here is the corrected issue-time value, derived exactly as idle_for_s - total_ms/1000. The timings themselves are as measured.
sample_note: The 3200 ms and 5000 ms rows pool two runs, 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-21, thirty first commands each; every other row is a single run of ten. Ten was not enough to separate the advertising cost from the receiver's connection retries at these intervals (decisions.md D-061).
